correctness.rationale: For each product energy shell, the allowed level-2 occupation interval is exactly [max(0,E-N),floor(E/2)]. Extremal logarithmic populations yield the stated odd-copy wedge and unchanged even-copy threshold. The ratio-coordinate Jacobian is \(u/(1+u+uv)^3\). Exact v integration yields the probability formula; a,b coordinates give integrable dominated convergence and positive \(C_f\). Tail integration establishes the moment threshold. Replayed packaged verifier confirms 384 independent rational finite examples and numerical quadrature. No infinite conclusion rests on finite tests.

value.rationale: Finite-copy work activation is a resource count in quantum thermodynamics. An exact ensemble survival law and the contrast between a.s. finite activation and infinite expected count are quantitatively nontrivial, motivate caution when reporting mean activation thresholds, and persist under a broad class of naturally weighted passive ensembles. Not a marginal numeric improvement or a restatement of the finite-copy criterion.
